┌─ Help: Every key ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Moving                                                                       │
│   Arrows, W A S D  walk a few metres that way                                │
│   E, Enter         go through the nearest door (stand at it)                 │
│   M                the whole zone you have seen                              │
│                                                                              │
│ Fighting                                                                     │
│   Tab              choose the next target                                    │
│   Esc              clear the target                                          │
│   F, Space         auto-attack on or off (none targeted: what attacks you)   │
│   1-8              use that slot's ability on your target                    │
│   B                set the ability slots (out of combat)                     │
│   R                when you are dead: give up your body and respawn          │
│                                                                              │
│ People and things                                                            │
│   G                talk to the nearest person                                │
│   L                loot the nearest drop you may take                        │
│   K                contracts you hold (X gives one up)                       │
│   Ctrl+K           your quest chain: its step; X dismisses it for good       │
│   N                traders: buy, sell, train, bind, bank                     │
│ Page 6 of 7  Up, Down scroll  ? next page  Left, Right turn  Esc closes      │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
 HP 100/100 | Target: none                                                      
 ONLINE | Testgrounds | heard N.Ns ago                            ? help  q quit
